recorded_risks.summary: Without -ApprovePersist, CLI could consult PATH/git before handler-based denial; now CLI refuses immediately after envelope creation.
Inherited GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/SYSTEM or future GIT_CONFIG_* overrides were not scrubbed; now remove all inherited GIT_CONFIG* keys.
Previously case-alias protected by full tracked-path inventory only on Windows; macOS may use case-insensitive volumes. EC157 adds macOS.
Store preflight used Test-Path for optional nodes and validated records after creating owner marker; now probes items with Get-Item and checks existing records node first.
Time-of-check/time-of-use swaps across Git probes and filesystem paths cannot be excluded without OS handle-relative operations; Source, HEAD or index may mutate mid-operation.
recorded_risks.follow_up: Final native adversarial safe-fixture tests; avoid claiming atomic security.
